note:
⛔ SNG-521. THE SUNK ASSAY, LEVEL 2 — THE FLOODED ASSAY. Four typed hazards, authored as OPPONENT SHEETS rather than as hazard records. ⚑ CCODE, SNG-515 §2: 'a hazard is an encounter FRAME KIND with no mechanic block — but a hazard that deals typed harm is AN OPPONENT WITH NO NAME, and `synthesizeOpponentSheet` already accepts a fully authored sheet.' ⚠️ So each hazard is one sheet with one skill, and nothing new was invented to carry it.
⛔ AND THE ANSWERS ARE OBJECTS, NOT WARD CRAFTS (A2a). The spec assumed a party answers `decay` by having Death-Ward up; ⚠️ ward `wardTypes` DO NOT YET FEED THE LAYER WALK. ✅ An authored `soakLayers` on gear IS honoured today — so the room hands you its own answers. ⚑ WHICH IS BETTER FOR A FIRST DUNGEON: the party finds the answer in the room rather than needing to have brought the right tradition.
_theClock: ⛔ THE WATER IS RISING AND NO ROUND CLOCK EXISTS (CCode §4). ⚠️ AUTHORED AS PRESSURE INSTEAD: every hazard here drives back rather than kills, and `breakAtPressure` is the drowning. ➡️ A party that keeps losing exchanges is pushed off the floor — which is what a rising tide DOES. ⬜ When the clock lands, swap the pressure exit for it; the content does not change.

opponents.name: The Grey Damp

soakLayers.source: ⛔ IT IS NOT THERE TO BE HIT — a blade in fog

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE ONE THAT TEACHES THE LESSON. `ongoingHarm: decay` means A WOUND TAKEN HERE DOES NOT CLOSE until the condition is lifted. ⚠️ THIS IS THE FIRST PLACE IN THE GAME WHERE A HEALER MUST END A CONDITION BEFORE MENDING — `resolveHeal` and `staunch` are both built and nothing has ever authored against them. ⚑ The party will discover it by failing: they will mend, watch it reopen, and only then read the room. ✅ ANSWERED BY `oiled_leathers` (decay 5). ⛔ NOT by armour — its `physical: 40` is not toughness, it is the point: you cannot hit weather. `targetPolicy: weakest` because damp finds whoever is already worst off.

opponents.name: The Assay-Light

soakLayers.source: it is made of the thing it is made of

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE ONE NO PHYSICAL WARD ANSWERS. It carries `pierce: 3`, so armour is not merely wrong — it is bypassed. ✅ ANSWERED ONLY BY `lattice_token` (precursor 6), which is the only precursor-typed protection in the game. ⚠️ AND IT READS: `senseFunctions: [reveal]` means the party's obscure pays here too, exactly as it does on Level 1. ⚑ `targetPolicy: strongest` — an assay measures the biggest thing in the room.

opponents.name: The Drowned Green

soakLayers.source: ⚠️ you CAN cut it — it simply grows back

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE ONE A SHIELD MAKES WORSE. Its `physical: 6` is deliberately LOW — cutting works, and cutting is the wrong answer, because it closes again and the round is gone. ✅ ANSWERED BY `cut_stone_and_salt` (living 6), ⚠️ WHICH IS CONSUMABLE — the party must decide where to spend it. ⚑ `hinder` in the pool because it holds you rather than kills you, and being held is how the water reaches you.

opponents.name: The Collapsing Gantry

soakLayers.source: ⛔ it is a structure and it does not care

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE ONLY ONE ARMOUR ANSWERS, AND THE ONE A STILL MIND DOES NOT. ⚠️ Unmoving Mind does not stop a spar. ✅ Answered by ordinary `physical` soak — every sheet already has some — ⚑ WHICH IS THE POINT OF PUTTING IT LAST: after three hazards that punished the obvious answer, the obvious answer is correct. ✅ `gantry_line` does not soak it — it is a ROUTE PAST it, and with Skydancer r3 it carries the whole party. `targetPolicy: random` because a falling floor does not choose.
opponents._answeredBy: gantry_line (as a route, not a ward)

_theTraverse: ⬜ Loose-Limbed, Skydancer, Near Way and Rising Step each open a different route across. ⚠️ A party with none of them takes the long way and loses exchanges to the pressure — ⛔ which under this authoring is the same thing as losing ground to the water.
_whatThisTests: ⛔ THE PAIRS THAT HAVE NEVER MET. CCode, SNG-515 §5: 'soak against typed damage, healing against ongoing harm, tempo against a foe that also reads — none of those pairs have met.' ⚑ THIS FLOOR IS THE SECOND: `ongoingHarm: decay` against `resolveHeal` and `staunch`, both built, both never exercised by content. ⚠️ If a heal closes a grey-damp wound without ending the condition first, THAT IS THE BUG THIS ROOM EXISTS TO FIND.
_notAuthored: ⬜ NO `ongoingHarm` FIELD EXISTS ON A CRAFT YET — CCode §2 says the skill on an authored sheet is where it would ride, and this file authors it at the OPPONENT level as the shape a reader would want. ⛔ IF NOTHING READS `ongoingHarm` HERE, THE GREY DAMP IS AN ORDINARY DECAY HAZARD AND THE LEVEL'S WHOLE LESSON IS INERT. ⚠️ That is the first thing to check when this is run.
